# three.js (vendored)

three.js r170 (npm package `three@0.170.0`), MIT license (LICENSE-three.js), unmodified:
`build/three.module.min.js`, `examples/jsm/controls/OrbitControls.js`,
`examples/jsm/loaders/STLLoader.js`, `examples/jsm/loaders/OBJLoader.js`.
Vendored so that the viewer works offline.

# JetBrains Mono (vendored)

`fonts/`: JetBrains Mono 2.304 from the npm package `@fontsource/jetbrains-mono@5.3.0`, SIL Open
Font License 1.1 (fonts/LICENSE-jetbrains-mono.txt), unmodified: the Latin and Greek subsets,
weights 400, 500 and 700 (woff2). The type of the brand (brand/README.md); declared in
`../fonts.css`, inlined by `freedyn2 view --export`.
